fixture_catalog.FX-BASE: Synthetic organizations A/B, unrelated cases, named requester/reviewer/authority/auditor/operator, same-role different principals, explicit grants; no real identities.
fixture_catalog.FX-UNCERTAIN: Original Arabic/English spellings, Arabic digits, NULL/approximate/disputed intervals, no-photo reports, impossible chronology and multiple revisions.
fixture_catalog.FX-MEDIA: Generated non-child drawings and consent-free geometric test images, EXIF/GPS canaries, multiple face-region adapter outputs, malformed/MIME/polyglot/decompression fixtures; no real child photos.
fixture_catalog.FX-IDP: Local test Keycloak realm, synthetic users, fresh/stale MFA, wrong issuer/audience, expired/revoked sessions and pooled connection contexts; disposable credentials.
fixture_catalog.FX-MATCH: Synthetic case/score/vector manifests, incompatible spaces, deliberate wrong leads, no-mate cases and human rejection; synthetic vectors cannot demonstrate recognition accuracy.
fixture_catalog.FX-APPROVAL: Synthetic claimant, missing/found pair, independently verified-authority fixture, distinct actors, same actor with two roles, revision/expiry/conflict variants.
fixture_catalog.FX-EVENT: Closed event envelopes with duplicate/reordered IDs, lease expiry, crash checkpoints, tombstone generations, provider stub receipts and deterministic clock.
fixture_catalog.FX-PURGE: Synthetic original/derivative/object versions, vector partitions, grants, exports, cache markers, queues and backup copies; scoped legal-hold variants.
fixture_catalog.FX-DB: Fresh/previous synthetic schema snapshots, actual non-owner DB roles, deliberate cross-org FK links, empty/missing tenant contexts, rollback/fault barriers.
fixture_catalog.FX-FAILURE: Isolated scanner/IdP/KMS/storage/audit/provider outages, latency/network partitions and process kills; no production failure injection.
fixture_catalog.FX-A11Y: Approved Arabic/English synthetic UI strings, mixed-direction IDs, 320/360/390/1280px viewports, keyboard/screen-reader scripts, 200% zoom/reduced motion.
fixture_catalog.FX-EVAL: Separately authorized subject-disjoint evaluation manifest with independent identity ground truth and rights record, restricted data store; never external testing models.
fixture_catalog.FX-DEPLOY: Immutable candidate/previous release digests, synthetic staging topology, migrations/WAL/object backups, independent deletion ledger and rollback approval fixture.

FX-FOUNDATION.description: Disposable internal-only PostgreSQL/pgvector, synthetic org/principal/case UUIDs, input-free bilingual shell, generated one-pixel sanitizer unit fixtures and synthetic validator reports. Validator unit fixtures never count as real browser/application evidence.

fixture_catalog.FX-REPORTING: Only generated synthetic contacts/names/receipts, separate NGO/staff principals, encrypted operator sinks, solid-color PNG/JPEG/WebP, inert EICAR test string, immutable S3 versions, real ClamAV, real PG non-owner roles and controlled crash/outage barriers. No real child images or production information.
